scripts.start: NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "python backend/run.py" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:8000 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run package-backend && electron-builder
scripts.package-backend: pip install pyinstaller && pyinstaller --clean --distpath build/bin backend.spec
